character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout the full music video: golden-brown hair in a loose braid, sunny amber eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a sunflower seed keeper preserving heirloom varieties on a family farm. Fixed signature outfit: a cream blouse with a golden-yellow apron dress, straw hat, and practical boots. Defining personal item: a small tin of sunflower seeds marked with the harvest year. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.
